item.title: Former soldier sentenced to life imprisonment for murder of Mid Kerry pensioner
item.description: A former soldier has been handed a life sentence for the murder of a mid Kerry pensioner. Last week, Thomas Carroll, with an address at Brookway, Clonmel, Co Tipperary was unanimously convicted of murdering Paddy O’Mahony near Castlemaine in February 2024. The 67-year-old retired soldier accepted that he fired the gun, but denied the charge of murder. item.title: Kerry Dairy Ireland appoints two independent non-executive directors
item.description: Kerry Dairy Ireland has appointed two independent non-executive directors. Roisín Hennerty and Patrick Mulvihill have taken up the positions. They both have over 30 years’ experience, including non-executive director roles. Advertisement Chair of Kerry Dairy Ireland, James Tagney, said they are delighted to welcome the new directors and that they will bring expertise and leadership to the business.

item.title: Ukrainian Christmas community event to take place in Tralee
item.description: A Ukrainian Christmas community event is taking place in Tralee this evening. It begins at 5:30pm in the Rose Hotel. The evening includes a decoration-making workshop, an introduction to Ukrainian Christmas traditions, and a nativity play from the Ukrainian School in Kerry. Advertisement The event is organised by the North, East and West Kerry Development.

item.title: Friend of Ashling Murphy recalls her connections to West Kerry
item.description: A friend of Ashling Murphy has spoken about the connection the murdered school teacher had to West Kerry. Laura Murray is PRO of the Ashling Murphy Memorial Fund which was set up to raise money for causes close to Ashling's heart. This includes Gaeltacht scholarship funds for second-level students to attend Coláiste Chamuis in Co Galway to improve their Irish language skills. item.title: County councillor suggests moving Farranfore train station closer to Kerry Airport for new transport hub
item.description: A Kerry county councillor has suggested moving Farranfore train station closer to the airport, to create a transport hub. Independent councillor Jackie Healy-Rae brought the idea to the recent meeting of Kerry County Council. He said a pedestrian link to the airport from an adjacent train station would best serve locals and tourists. item.title: Dáil hears North Kerry school roof in “bad state”
item.description: A Kerry TD has told the Dáil that the roof of a North Kerry school is in a “bad state”. Sinn Fein’s deputy Pa Daly raised the issue of the hall roof at Scoil Réalta na Maidine, the Listowel Boys School, in Listowel recently. The hall was built around 1960, and is named in honour of its former principal, the well-known writer Bryan McMahon. Advertisement It was refused funding under the Climate Action Grant Scheme. item.title: Kerry Fianna Fáil councillor says Taoiseach's role in disastrous presidential campaign has 'weakened' him
item.description: A Kerry Fianna Fáil councillor says the Taoiseach's role in the party's disastrous presidential campaign has weakened him. At a special party meeting last night, the Fianna Fáil leader's handling of the selection of Jim Gavin was severely criticised. Cllr Mikey Sheehy says other senior party figures who backed Mr Gavin also hold responsibility. item.title: First section of South Kerry greenway to open to public on Friday
item.description: The first section of the South Kerry greenway will open to the public on Friday. This first phase will be just over 3kms and it's in Kells. It's expected that the next section of the South Kerry greenway will be opened by early summer next year. item.title: Over €20,000 raised for St Vincent de Paul through Radio Kerry Christmas Jumper Day 2025
item.description: Over €20,000 has now been raised for St Vincent de Paul Kerry by Radio Kerry’s twelfth annual Christmas Jumper Day. This year’s Christmas Jumper Day was on December 11th but the people of Kerry have continued to donate across the last week. It has now raised over €20,130 this year alone for the charity, and around €200,000 since it was first launched.
